ESTIMATOR, declared here so both sides apply one rule: the trajectory projected on the line joining the traps, +x from trap_1 to trap_2 and trap_1 at negative x; cores around the two peaks of the pooled record's histogram, core radius 0.2 of the peak spacing (the simulation's milestone_core_fraction); sticky milestoning at the frame interval. Occupancy is time assigned to a well; each ordered rate is transitions out over time assigned to the origin well; residence is the registered renewal form, with the mean completed dwell beside it; barrier from -k_B*T ln P(x). ONE BEAD, TWO TRAPS. The person's protocol: equal strengths first, tune the separation to two histogram peaks with a small barrier, then weaken trap_2 in small steps -- at a strength ratio of 0.5 or below there are no hops at any separation. Strength trims are written as small separate steps: a strength change has no step limit in the envelope, and one step could release the bead.
